info.name: Govee Developer Device Control Scenes API

items.docs: Returns the dynamic (light) scenes supported by a device - Govee's built-in lighting effects. Each scene is returned as a selectable option that can be applied through POST /device/control using the dynamic_scene capability.

Returns the user-created DIY scenes supported by a device - custom lighting effects authored in the Govee Home App. Each is returned as a selectable option applied through POST /device/control using the diy_scene capability.
